title: rosa glauca subsp. pouzinii
intro: Rosa glauca subsp. pouzinii, commonly known as the "Blue Rose", is a subspecies of the Rosa glauca plant, a species of rose native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health. The health benefits of Rosa glauca subsp. pouzinii include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been shown to have a positive impact on various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular function.
